name: Village Inn
description: Four-storey rendered auberge. Ground-floor dining room with bar and cider barrels; three floors of small guest rooms off a rear corridor. Main stair and a separate service stair at opposite ends. B2: a round-arched arcade on six columns carries a first-floor terrace; half-timbered upper storeys with a balcony, string courses, chamfered plinth, keystoned surrounds, dormers, capped chimneys, ivy on the east gable.
